## Keywords

{{< glossary slides-from-outline speaker-notes presenter-view check-ai-output ai-use-statement rehearsal >}}

## 10.1 From the report to five slides

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Five slides are enough for a talk of three minutes.
- Slides from Outline makes them from the Heading 1 lines of the report.
- The chart comes from Excel, and each slide has few words.
- **Lab task:** Make your five slides. Which two insights go on slide 4?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/five-slides.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 1 · Five slides

a) Which slide shows the answer to the project question in a picture?
b) What does a Heading 1 line become with Slides from Outline?
c) Which slide has the thanks and the AI-use line?

::: {.answer}
a) slide 3, the chart
b) a slide title
c) slide 5, the end
:::

## 10.2 Check every slide

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Every number must be the same as in Excel.
- Every sentence must be shown by the data.
- AI pictures must fit, and the last slide says where AI helped.
- **Lab task:** Check your five slides. Which problem did you fix?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/slide-checks.png)
:::
::::

## Live demo · Deck Checker

{{< sim file="sims/deck-checker.html" poster="sims/deck-checker.png" title="Deck Checker: ready to present?" task="**Show:** mark slide 3 as OK, read the facts, then mark it again. **Ask:** how do we fix each of the four problems?" >}}

## Example · Two mistakes on Sami's slides

Sami's slide 3 says "Total: 451 JD", and slide 4 says "Everyone loves sandwiches."
**What is wrong, and how does Sami fix it?**

::: {.reveal}
1. Excel says **415 JD**: two digits were swapped.
2. The data shows sales, **not what everyone loves**.
3. Sami writes "Sandwiches earned the most: **138 JD**."
:::

## Try it 2 · Four checks

a) Which check fails when a slide says 451 JD and Excel says 415 JD?
b) Which check fails when an AI picture shows a big restaurant for a small canteen?
c) Which check fails when AI wrote the outline and no slide says so?

::: {.answer}
a) accuracy
b) pictures
c) honesty
:::

## 10.3 Present in three minutes

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- Speaker notes are short reminders under each slide.
- Presenter View shows the notes, the next slide and a timer.
- One rehearsal with a timer checks the time of the talk.
- **Lab task:** Rehearse your talk once. How long did it take?
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
![](images/presenter-view.png)
:::
::::

## Try it 3 · Presenting

a) How long should each of five slides take?
b) What do we see in Presenter View that the class does not see?
c) What do we say when we cannot answer a question?

::: {.answer}
a) about 30–40 seconds
b) the notes, the next slide and a timer
c) We say so, and how we could find out.
:::

## Game challenge · Presentation Day

{{< sim file="sims/presentation-day.html" poster="sims/presentation-day.png" title="Presentation Day: six situations" kind="game" task="**The story:** every student presents a course project in three minutes. **Play:** choose the best thing to do in six situations." >}}

## Try it 4 · Presentation day (harder)

The facts: the rehearsal takes 4 minutes, the talk is at 2:40 with two slides left, and the teacher asks if AI wrote the insights.

a) What do we do when the rehearsal takes 4 minutes?
b) What do we do when two slides are left at 2:40?
c) What do we say when the teacher asks about AI help?

::: {.answer}
a) Cut one sentence on each slide.
b) Say the main insight and finish.
c) Where AI helped, and how we checked it.
:::

## Summary

- Five slides make a talk of three minutes.
- Four checks come before every talk.
- Notes, Presenter View and a rehearsal help us present.
- We say honestly where AI helped.
